title: test: concurrent C_Login/C_Logout session state correctness
description:
C_Login sets per-slot state (soft_pin, soft_pin_len, logged_in) and per-session state. Concurrent login/logout has not been tested.

Write tests in test/wp11_test_pkcs11_threads.c:

Test 1 — concurrent login same slot:
- 4 threads all call C_Login(CKU_USER, '1234') on different sessions on the same slot simultaneously
- Success criterion: all return CKR_OK or CKR_USER_ALREADY_LOGGED_IN — never CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED or a crash
- soft_pin must be coherent (not half-written) after all threads complete

Test 2 — login/logout interleave:
- Thread A: C_Login → 100ms sleep → C_Logout → repeat
- Thread B: C_Login → check C_Login returns CKR_USER_ALREADY_LOGGED_IN → repeat
- Success criterion: soft_pin_len never observed as partially written; mlock/munlock calls balanced

Test 3 — login then concurrent key generation:
- C_Login, then 8 threads simultaneously call C_GenerateKeyPair
- Success criterion: each thread gets a distinct key handle; no key handle returned twice; all keys sign correctly (independent oracle: wc_ecc_verify_hash)
- Detects: g_keys[] slot allocation races

Test 4 — wrong PIN under concurrent correct-PIN login:
- Thread A: C_Login with correct PIN
- Thread B: simultaneously C_Login with wrong PIN
- Success criterion: Thread A succeeds, Thread B gets CKR_PIN_INCORRECT; soft_pin contains correct PIN after race

Run with -fsanitize=thread. Check soft_pin buffer alignment and atomicity with helgrind.
